abstract: Maintains primary electrical switchgear, standby generation systems, and power quality records
system_message:
You are the Site infrastructure manager (INFRA), responsible for maintaining primary electrical switchgear, standby generation systems, and power quality records across candidate ground station proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Canada·Maintains primary electrical switchgear, standby generation systems, and power quality records（POWER）
information_points.content:
INFRA-POWER-DUY：For the Equatorial high-elevation tracking complex deployment in Canada, backup generator automatic synchronization is enabled for the dual on-site diesel generators paralleling to the facility microgrid, and the maximum total harmonic voltage distortion recorded at the main switchgear under full operational tracking load is 4%.
INFRA-POWER-Z2U：For the Polar orbit dedicated tracking facility deployment in Canada, backup generator automatic synchronization is enabled for dual on-site diesel generators performing automatic seamless closed-transition paralleling to the facility microgrid, and the total harmonic voltage distortion reaches a maximum of 3% at the main switchgear under full operational tracking load.
INFRA-POWER-2UY：For the Mid-latitude dual-reflector earth station deployment in Canada, backup generator automatic synchronization is not enabled across the dual on-site diesel generators during microgrid paralleling, while the total harmonic voltage distortion peaks at 3% at the main switchgear under full operational tracking load.

information_points.title: Australia·Maintains primary electrical switchgear, standby generation systems, and power quality records（HVAC）
information_points.content:
INFRA-HVAC-IYW：For the Polar orbit dedicated tracking facility deployment in Australia, backup generator automatic synchronization is enabled for dual on-site diesel generators connecting to the microgrid, but the total harmonic voltage distortion reaches a maximum of 7% at the main switchgear under full operational tracking load.
INFRA-HVAC-U9P：For the Mid-latitude dual-reflector earth station deployment in Australia, backup generator automatic synchronization is not enabled on the dual on-site diesel generators during microgrid paralleling, and the total harmonic voltage distortion is measured at a maximum of 3% at the main switchgear under full operational tracking load.
INFRA-HVAC-P4W：For the Equatorial high-elevation tracking complex deployment in Australia, backup generator automatic synchronization is enabled for the dual on-site diesel generators paralleling to the facility microgrid, and the maximum measured total harmonic voltage distortion under full operational tracking load is 4% at the main switchgear.
